scenarios.title: Discover exiles until a nonland card of mana value N or less, casts it free or puts it in hand, and bottoms the rest

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first.

decisions: A casts Geological Appraiser, tapping four Mountains; it resolves and enters the battlefield.
Its enters trigger ('if you cast it, discover 3') goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.
A discovers 3: cards are exiled from the top of A's library until a nonland card with mana value 3 or less is exiled. A chooses to cast that card without paying its mana cost; it resolves.

variants.label: cast_free
variants.expected: Forest and Centaur Courser (mana value 3) are exiled. A casts Centaur Courser for free and it enters the battlefield. Forest goes to the bottom of A's library; A's library is Grizzly Bears, Island, Forest. A's hand is empty.

variants.label: put_in_hand
variants.delta: A chooses to put the discovered card into their hand instead of casting it.
variants.expected: Centaur Courser is put into A's hand and is not on the battlefield. Forest goes to the bottom of A's library; A's library is Grizzly Bears, Island, Forest.

variants.label: first_card_too_big
variants.delta: The second card of A's library is Hill Giant (mana value 4) instead of Centaur Courser.
variants.expected: Forest and Hill Giant are exiled but Hill Giant is not discovered, so the exiling continues: Grizzly Bears (mana value 2) is exiled and A casts it for free. Forest and Hill Giant go to the bottom of A's library in a random order; A's library is Island followed by Forest and Hill Giant.

scenarios.title: A player has discovered, and discover triggers fire, even when no card could be found

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first. Val, Marooned Surveyor is on the battlefield.

decisions: A casts Geological Appraiser, tapping four Mountains; it resolves and enters the battlefield.
Its enters trigger ('if you cast it, discover 3') goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.
A discovers 3; if a card is found, A casts it without paying its mana cost. Both players pass until Val's trigger, if any, resolves.

variants.label: nothing_found
variants.expected: No card in A's library is a nonland card of mana value 3 or less, so all three cards are exiled and put back on the bottom in a random order; nothing is cast and nothing goes to A's hand. A has still discovered: Val triggers, dealing 2 damage to B (B at 18) and A gains 2 life (A at 22).

variants.label: card_found
variants.delta: The second card of A's library is Grizzly Bears instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Forest and Grizzly Bears are exiled; A casts Grizzly Bears for free and it enters the battlefield. A has discovered: Val triggers, B is at 18 and A is at 22.

variants.label: val_controlled_by_B
variants.delta: Val, Marooned Surveyor is on B's battlefield instead of A's.
variants.expected: A discovers and nothing is found, but Val triggers only when its controller discovers, so it does not trigger: both players stay at 20.

scenarios.title: The final exiled card is the discovered card whether it was cast or put into hand

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first.

decisions: A casts Hit the Mother Lode, tapping seven Mountains.
Both players pass; it resolves and A discovers 10: cards are exiled from the top of A's library until a nonland card with mana value 10 or less is exiled.
A chooses to cast the discovered card without paying its mana cost; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: cast
variants.expected: Forest and Serra Angel (mana value 5) are exiled; Serra Angel is the discovered card and is cast and enters the battlefield. Hit the Mother Lode creates 10 - 5 = 5 tapped Treasure tokens under A's control.

variants.label: put_in_hand
variants.delta: A chooses to put the discovered card into their hand instead of casting it.
variants.expected: Serra Angel is put into A's hand. It is still the discovered card, so A still gets 5 tapped Treasure tokens.

variants.label: cheaper_card
variants.delta: The second card of A's library is Grizzly Bears (mana value 2) instead of Serra Angel.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is the discovered card and is cast; A gets 10 - 2 = 8 tapped Treasure tokens.

variants.label: no_card_found
variants.delta: The second card of A's library is Plains instead of Serra Angel, so A's library holds only lands.
variants.expected: Every card is exiled and put back on the bottom in a random order; no card is cast or put into hand and there is no discovered card, so A gets no Treasure tokens.
